title_en: Jewish protestors join Free Palestine march to denounce Netanyahu
excerpt_en: Al Jazeera’s Emma Withrow reports from a Free Palestine march, where Jewish demonstrators rejected Netanyahu.

title_en: Contrasting treatment of Israel and Palestine on display at the UN

title_en: UNRWA work and mandate in ‘jeopardy’, Guterres warns
excerpt_en: The UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine refugees (UNRWA) continues to operate under “extraordinary pressure”, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said on Thursday.

title_en: Palestinian existence under threat, Abbas tells UN, warning of ‘another Nakba’
excerpt_en: Israeli policies now threaten “the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland”, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas told the UN General Assembly on Thursday, urging the world not to allow “another Nakba”.

title_en: Netanyahu calls Macron's remarks on West Bank in UN speech 'grotesque'
excerpt_en: Israel's PM denounces the French president after he appeared to downplay Hamas's activities in the occupied territory.

title_en: Reports of violence against women in Gaza surge, UN agency finds
excerpt_en: The UN Population Fund also says there has been a "severe escalation" in the number of early and forced marriages.

title_en: ‘Time is running out’ for Israel-Palestine two-State solution
excerpt_en: The UN chief warned on Tuesday that the two-State solution for the Israel-Palestine conflict is at risk of collapse amid illegal Israeli settlement expansion and annexation.

title_en: Gaza: At least 20 killed in deadly building collapse, search for survivors continues
excerpt_en: Search and rescue operations continued in Gaza City on Wednesday following the collapse of a bombed-out building that killed at least 20 people, according to reports.

title_en: Gaza remains recovery points to possible war crimes, says UN rights chief
excerpt_en: Bodies are still being pulled from the rubble of Gaza, three years after Israeli bombardment flattened entire neighbourhoods – most of them women and children.

title_en: ‘Where do we go?’: How Israel’s ‘yellow line’ is closing in on Palestinians
excerpt_en: Ola Ishtiwi sits with her children in front of the remains of her home in the Al-Tuffah neighbourhood in eastern Gaza City, a few metres away from a series of painted cement blocks Israel has placed to mark what has become known as the “yellow line”.

title_en: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
excerpt_en: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.

title_en: In Gaza, women-headed households face ‘impossible choices’ to survive
excerpt_en: In war-torn Gaza, a growing number of women-headed households face “impossible decisions” every day, amid ongoing Israeli airstrikes and still-scarce resources, UN humanitarians said on Tuesday.
